source_context: Earlier O05 dry-end stabilization research reconciled against the current authoritative B1.10 constitutive formula

clarification.quantity: Jacobian capacity regularization, not a physical K cutoff

reconciliation: The earlier -800000 cm marker is not the O05 C=1e-13 crossing. Direct evaluation of the authoritative constitutive relation places C=1e-13 at about -264278 cm. Around -800000 cm the raw C value is already about 4.1e-15; the previously recorded ~1.7e-9 quantity corresponds to theta-theta_r scale, not C.
interpretation_for_AHL: Adaptive lookup generation should not keep adding resolution indefinitely in the extreme dry tail once storage response is numerically negligible.
The 1e-13 scale must not be reinterpreted as a physical truncation of theta(h) or K(h).
The historical dt*1e-13 term is a Newton/Jacobian regularization authority, not a constitutive K cutoff.
Any explicit dry-tail termination or asymptotic replacement still requires prospective continuity and solver-response qualification.
The F-AHL10/F-AHL12 dry regimes around hundreds of cm are ordinary dry conditions and are not covered by this extreme-tail rule.
